"He got switched off without his folks--and I've got a pet lamb in the baggage-room bleatin' at the corporation since dinner-time. Some galoot forgot the crittur. There's a lost parrot settin' alongside that swears in several foreign languages. I wish to Moses I could!"

arxiv-1910-11081.title: Black Hole Horizons as Patternless Binary Messages and Markers of Dimensionality
arxiv-1910-11081.creator: Szymon Łukaszyk
arxiv-1910-11081.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Szymon Łukaszyk. This study aims to reconcile quantum theory with the universality of the speed of light in vacuum and its implications on relativity through an information-theoretic approach. We introduce the concepts of a holographic sphere and variational potential. Entropy variation expressed in terms of the information capacity of this sphere results in the concept of binary potential in units of negative, squared speed of light in vacuum.

arxiv-1912-03769.title: ragamAI: A Network Based Recommender System to Arrange a Indian Classical Music Concert
arxiv-1912-03769.creator: Arunkumar Bagavathi 1 , Siddharth Krishnan 2 , Sanjay Subrahmanyan, S.L. Narasimhan
arxiv-1912-03769.description: Abstract South Indian classical music ( Carnatic music ) is best consumed through live concerts. A carnatic recital requires meticulous planning accounting for several parameters like the performers’ repertoire, composition variety, musical versatility, thematic structure, the recital’s arrangement, etc. to ensure that the audience have a comprehensive listening experience.

arxiv-2108-06959.title: WikiChurches: A Fine-Grained Dataset of Architectural Styles with Real-World Challenges
arxiv-2108-06959.creator: Björn Barz, Joachim Denzler
arxiv-2108-06959.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Björn Barz, Joachim Denzler. We introduce a novel dataset for architectural style classification, consisting of 9,485 images of church buildings. Both images and style labels were sourced from Wikipedia. The dataset can serve as a benchmark for various research fields, as it combines numerous real-world challenges: fine-grained distinctions between classes based on subtle visual features, a comparatively small sample size, a highly imbalanced class distribution, a high variance of viewpoints, and a hierarchical organization of labels, where only some images are labeled at the

arxiv-2207-11656.title: Non-asymptotic near optimal algorithms for two sided matchings
arxiv-2207-11656.creator: Rahul Vaze, Jayakrishnan Nair
arxiv-2207-11656.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rahul Vaze, Jayakrishnan Nair. A two-sided matching system is considered, where servers are assumed to arrive at a fixed rate, while the arrival rate of customers is modulated via a price-control mechanism. We analyse a loss model, wherein customers who are not served immediately upon arrival get blocked, as well as a queueing model, wherein customers wait in a queue until they receive service.

arxiv-2304-10514.title: Deformation of d = 4 , 𝒩 ≥ 5 d=4,\,\,\mathcal{N}\geq 5 Supergravities Breaks Nonlinear Local Supersymmetry
arxiv-2304-10514.creator: Renata Kallosh, and Yusuke Yamada
arxiv-2304-10514.description: Abstract We study d = 4 , 𝒩 ≥ 5 d=4,\,\mathcal{N}\geq 5 supergravities and their deformation via candidate counterterms, with the purpose to absorb UV divergences. We generalize the earlier studies of deformation and twisted self-duality constraint to the case with unbroken local ℋ \mathcal{H} -symmetry in presence of fermions. We find that the deformed action breaks nonlinear local supersymmetry.

arxiv-2307-03221.title: Astrometry with Extended-Path Intensity Correlation
arxiv-2307-03221.creator: Ken Van Tilburg, Masha Baryakhtar, Marios Galanis, Neal Weiner
arxiv-2307-03221.description: Abstract Intensity interferometry—the correlation of spatially separated light intensities—has historically been an important tool for precision optical astronomical observations. However, due to the extremely narrow field of view, its scope has been limited to studies of the morphology of very bright emission regions, primarily determinations of angular diameters of nearby hot stars.

arxiv-2309-09207.title: Cramér-Rao Bound Optimization for Active RIS-Empowered ISAC Systems Thanks: Q. Zhu and M. Li are with the School of Information and Communication Engineering, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, China (e-mail: qzhu@mail.dlut.edu.cn; mli@dlut.edu.cn). Thanks: R. Liu is with the Center for
arxiv-2309-09207.creator: Qi Zhu, Ming Li, Senior Member, IEEE , Rang Liu, Member, IEEE , and Qian Liu, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2309-09207.description: Abstract Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), which simultaneously performs sensing and communication functions within a shared frequency band and hardware platform, has emerged as a promising technology for future wireless systems. Nevertheless, the weak echo signal received by the low-sensitivity ISAC receiver significantly constrains sensing performance in scenarios involving obstructed targets.

arxiv-2312-02624.title: Conductivity of concentrated salt solutions
arxiv-2312-02624.creator: Olga I. Vinogradova, Elena F. Silkina
arxiv-2312-02624.description: Abstract The conductivity of concentrated salt solutions has posed a real puzzle for theories of electrolytes. Despite a quantitative understanding of dilute solutions, an analytical theory for concentrated ones remains a challenge almost a century, although a number of parameters and effects incorporated into theories increases with time.

arxiv-2312-06769.title: Heavy Black Hole Seed Formation in High-z Atomic Cooling Halos
arxiv-2312-06769.creator: Lewis R. Prole , John A. Regan, Simon C. O. Glover, Ralf S. Klessen, Felix D. Priestley, Paul C. Clark
arxiv-2312-06769.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lewis R. Prole , John A. Regan, Simon C. O. Glover, Ralf S. Klessen, Felix D. Priestley, Paul C. Clark. Halos with masses in excess of the atomic limit are believed to be ideal environments in which to form heavy black hole seeds with masses above 10 3 10^{3} M ⊙ . In cases where the H 2 \rm{H_{2}} fraction is suppressed this is expected to lead to reduced fragmentation of the gas and the generation of a top heavy initial mass function.

arxiv-2401-04852.title: Answer Retrieval in Legal Community Question Answering
arxiv-2401-04852.creator: Arian Askari, Zihui Yang, Zhaochun Ren, Suzan Verberne
arxiv-2401-04852.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Arian Askari, Zihui Yang, Zhaochun Ren, Suzan Verberne. The task of answer retrieval in the legal domain aims to help users to seek relevant legal advice from massive amounts of professional responses. Two main challenges hinder applying existing answer retrieval approaches in other domains to the legal domain: (1) a huge knowledge gap between lawyers and non-professionals; and (2) a mix of informal and formal content on legal QA websites.

arxiv-2401-12846.title: How well can \chadded [id=addr3]a large language model \chdeleted [id=addr3]s explain business processes as perceived by users? Note: This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon research and innovation programme under grant agreements no 101092639 (FAME), 101094905 (AI4GOV),
arxiv-2401-12846.creator: Dirk Fahland, Fabiana Fournier, Lior Limonad, Inna Skarbovsky, Ava J.E. Swevels
arxiv-2401-12846.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are trained on a vast amount of text to interpret and generate human-like textual content. They are becoming a vital vehicle in realizing the vision of the autonomous enterprise, with organizations today actively adopting LLMs to automate many aspects of their operations.

arxiv-2402-14461.title: S 2 Former-OR: Single-Stage Bi-Modal Transformer for Scene Graph Generation in OR Thanks: J. Pei, D. Guo, J. Zhang, and P.-A. Heng are with the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, P.-A. Heng is also with the Institute of Medical Intelligence and XR, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, H
arxiv-2402-14461.creator: Jialun Pei, Diandian Guo, Jingyang Zhang, Manxi Lin, Yueming Jin
arxiv-2402-14461.description: Abstract Scene graph generation (SGG) of surgical procedures is crucial in enhancing holistically cognitive intelligence in the operating room (OR). However, previous works have primarily relied on multi-stage learning, where the generated semantic scene graphs depend on intermediate processes with pose estimation and object detection.

arxiv-2412-06951.title: Analysing Public Transport User Sentiment on Low Resource Multilingual Data
arxiv-2412-06951.creator: Rozina Myoya, Vukosi Marivate, Idris Abdulmumin
arxiv-2412-06951.description: Abstract Public transport systems in many Sub-Saharan countries often receive less attention compared to other sectors, underscoring the need for innovative solutions to improve the Quality of Service (QoS) and overall user experience. This study explored commuter opinion mining to understand sentiments toward existing public transport systems in Kenya, Tanzania, and South Africa.

arxiv-2509-15161.title: Discrete measured groupoid von Neumann algebras via the Gaussian deformation
arxiv-2509-15161.creator: Felipe Flores & James Harbour
arxiv-2509-15161.description: Abstract Given a discrete measured groupoid 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , we study properties of the corresponding von Neumann algebra L ⁡ ( 𝒢 ) L(\mathcal{G}) using the techniques of Popa’s deformation/rigidity theory. More specifically, we define and study the Gaussian deformation associated with any 1 1 -cocycle of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} and use it to prove primeness and fullness under appropriate assumptions.

arxiv-2511-03028.title: Chromatic numbers of rank-two Abelian Cayley graphs
arxiv-2511-03028.creator: Mike Krebs, Alejandro Leyva
arxiv-2511-03028.description: Abstract . A connected Cayley graph for an Abelian group generated by a finite symmetric subset S S can be represented by an integer matrix, its Heuberger matrix. We call the number of columns of that matrix its rank and the number of rows its dimension .

britannica-1911-roberval-gilles-personne.title: Roberval, Gilles Personne de (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-roberval-gilles-personne.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-roberval-gilles-personne.description: Article 'Roberval, Gilles Personne de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. (1602–1675), French mathematician, was born at Roberval, near Beauvais, on the 8th of August 1602. His name was originally Gilles Personne, that of Roberval, by which he is known, being taken from the place of his birth. Like René Descartes, he was present at the siege of La Rochelle in 1627.

pmc-10663669.title: Identification of ethyl vanillin in strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa) using a targeted metabolomics strategy: From artificial to natural
pmc-10663669.creator: Xuebo Song, Mark E Porter, Vance M Whitaker, Seonghee Lee, Yu Wang

pmc-10667724.title: Top of basilar syndrome due to vertebral artery dissection: How high-resolution MRI and CD31 analysis of thrombus could help
pmc-10667724.creator: Yu Wang, Yao Zhang, Yang Wang, He Liu, Yunpeng Liu
pmc-10667724.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Introduction and importanceVertebral artery dissection is a rare but serious condition that can lead to neurological deficits and even death. It is commonly associated with trauma or underlying vascular diseases. Top of basilar syndrome (TOBS) is a neurological condition that can result from vertebral artery dissection, either by direct ischemia or secondary occlusion due to distal embolization of injured inner vascular tissue.

pmc-11340127.title: Disulfidptosis-associated LncRNA signature predicts prognosis and immune response in kidney renal clear cell carcinoma
pmc-11340127.creator: Kangjie Xu, Dongling Li, Kangkang Ji, Yanhua Zhang, Minglei Zhang, Hai Zhou, Xuefeng Hou, Jian Jiang, Zihang Zhang, Hua Dai, Hang Sun
pmc-11340127.description: BackgroundKidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC) represents a significant proportion of renal cell carcinomas and is characterized by high aggressiveness and poor prognosis despite advancements in immunotherapy. Disulfidptosis, a novel cell death pathway, has emerged as a critical mechanism in various cellular processes, including cancer.

pmc-11356920.title: A Comprehensive Review Exploring the Protective Role of Specific Commensal Gut Bacteria against Salmonella
pmc-11356920.creator: Saloni Singh, Ok Kyung Koo, Elena Circella, Marialaura Corrente
pmc-11356920.description: Gut microbiota is a diverse community of microorganisms that constantly work to protect the gut against pathogens. Salmonella stands out as a notorious foodborne pathogen that interacts with gut microbes, causing an imbalance in the overall composition of microbiota and leading to dysbiosis. This review focuses on the interactions between Salmonella and the key commensal bacteria such as E.

pmc-11498138.title: Peptide-Coated Polycaprolactone-Benzalkonium Chloride Nanocapsules for Targeted Drug Delivery to the Pancreatic β-Cell
pmc-11498138.creator: Jillian Collins, Jessie M. Barra, Keifer Holcomb, Andres Ocampo, Ashton Fremin, Austin Kratz, Jubril Akolade, Julianna K. Hays, Ali Shilleh, Amit Sela, David J. Hodson, Johannes Broichhagen, Holger A. Russ, Nikki L. Farnsworth
pmc-11498138.description: Targeting current therapies to treat or prevent the loss of pancreatic islet β-cells in Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) may provide improved efficacy and reduce off-target effects. Current efforts to target the β-cell are limited by a lack of β-cell-specific targets and the inability to test multiple targeting moieties with the same delivery vehicle.

pmc-11655148.title: Probiotics and Phytobiotics as Dietary and Water Supplements in Biofloc Aquaculture Systems
pmc-11655148.creator: Mohammad Hossein Khanjani, Moslem Sharifinia, Mohammad Akhavan-Bahabadi, Maurício Gustavo Coelho Emerenciano
pmc-11655148.description: Biofloc technology (BFT) is a relatively new microbial-based cultivation system that can be adopted to accomplish more sustainable aquaculture and circularity goals. This review explores aspects of BFT integrating the utilization of probiotics and phytobiotics as dietary and water supplements.

pmc-12613303.title: Creating together, growing together: a qualitative study of adolescent experiences in an inclusive, co-creative performing arts project
pmc-12613303.creator: Eva Mari Andreasen, Thomas Westergren
pmc-12613303.description: PurposeAdolescence is a formative period marked by exploration, identity formation, and a growing need for belonging. Co-creative performing arts practices may support learning and relationship-building across diverse groups of young people. This study explored how adolescents without disabilities, enrolled in mainstream educational programmes, experienced and reflected on their participation in a long-term, inclusive, co-creative performing arts project (SPOR).

pmc-12615491.title: Attitudes towards the treatment of nausea and vomiting in pregnancy: results from a nationwide online study in Germany
pmc-12615491.creator: Mandy Mangler, Kirsten Kuhlmann, Florian Kohlhepp, Theresa Steeb, Wolfgang E. Paulus
pmc-12615491.description: BackgroundNausea and vomiting in pregnancy (NVP) affect up to 85% of pregnant individuals, predominantly in the first trimester. While most cases are mild, moderate to severe NVP can significantly impair quality of life and require medical intervention. Besides, safety concerns often influence decision-making.

pmc-12656876.title: Pregnancy-Associated Glycoproteins Identification in Skopelos Goat Milk by Means of Mass Spectrometry
pmc-12656876.creator: Efterpi Bouroutzika, Ekaterini K Theodosiadou, Stavros Proikakis, Irene Valasi, George Th Tsangaris, Gregory Johnson
pmc-12656876.description: Simple SummaryThis study is an attempt to identify pregnancy-associated glycoproteins (PAGs) by means of proteomics methods, specifically LC/MS-MS, in caprine milk. PAGs are specific proteins expressed in the placenta of Cetartiodactyla-order species, including all ruminants, during pregnancy. Milk samples from 20 Skopelos breed goats were analyzed.

pmc-12663641.title: Mobile telephone provider to provider helpline: A pilot study in Cameroon
pmc-12663641.creator: Comfort Enah, Victoria Jauk, Mary Glory Ngong, Christyenne Lily Bond, Lionel Neba Ambe, Rahel Mbah Kyeng, Roland Mbole, Waldemar A. Carlo, Gregory Halle-Ekane, Pius Muffih Tih, Jeff Szychowski, Henna Budhwani, Alan Thevenet N. Tita
pmc-12663641.description: BackgroundDespite the availability of effective strategies, countries in Sub-Saharan Africa continue to be disproportionately affected by maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality. Mobile health interventions are recognized for their potential usefulness in addressing gaps to quality maternal and neonatal care in low-income countries, including those for health care providers.

pmc-13104488.title: Development and psychometric evaluation of the DysPalKT for assessing nurses’ knowledge of dyspnoea care in patients with cancer receiving palliative care
pmc-13104488.creator: Johanna Kero, Jaana-Maija Koivisto, Minna Stolt, Elina Haavisto
pmc-13104488.description: BackgroundDyspnoea is one of the most prevalent and distressing symptoms among patients with advanced cancer receiving palliative care. Nurses, particularly in non-specialist settings, often report insufficient preparedness in managing dyspnoea. Despite its clinical relevance, existing tests inadequately assess nurses’ knowledge of dyspnoea care.

pmc-13217041.title: Fifteen-minute consultation: Modern diagnostic approach to the child with recurrent fractures
pmc-13217041.creator: Alexandra Blaschitz, Wolfgang Högler
pmc-13217041.description: Children and young people presenting with recurrent fractures pose a diagnostic challenge for clinicians. Such patients require early referral to a tertiary paediatric centre with bone specialists and a multidisciplinary team taking a comprehensive, modern approach to unravel the underlying causes.

pmc-13431689.title: Sleep circuit modulation: from animal models to human translation
pmc-13431689.creator: Zixiao Yin, Yichen Xu, Yu-Ting Tseng, Wolf-Julian Neumann, Hagai Bergman, Huiling Tan, Jianguo Zhang

pmc-13458789.title: An achromatic neutron lens
pmc-13458789.creator: Mano raj Dhanalakshmi Veeraraj, Di Qu, Hui-Yuan Chen, Silas Strebel, Peng Qi, Anna Fedrigo, Lukas Helfen, Alessandro Tengattini, Matteo Busi, Hongchang Wang, Piero Tranchida, Anders Kaestner, Christian David, Markus Strobl, Joan Vila-Comamala
pmc-13458789.description: Neutrons provide exceptional insight into materials, owing to their sensitivity to light elements, isotopic composition, magnetic moments, and high-penetration. However, neutron sources are polychromatic and of low brightness. Neutron optics provides a route to address these limitations by focusing, and to date, various types of neutron optics have been developed based on reflection, refraction, diffraction, and magnetism.

uslaw-cfr-t42-s93-231.title: 42 C.F.R. § 93.231 — Recklessly.
uslaw-cfr-t42-s93-231.creator: Public Health Service, Department Of Health And Human Services
uslaw-cfr-t42-s93-231.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 42 (Public Health), Part 93 (Public Health Service Policies On Research Misconduct).
